Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring disclosure of school district collective bargaining agreements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to disclosure of collective bargaining agreementsentered into by school districts; and adding a new section to chapter28A.320 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.320RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Within thirty days of the effective date of this section, eachschool district shall cause a true and correct copy of all collectivebargaining agreements then in effect entered into by the district andan employee organization, and all subsequent collective bargainingagreements entered into by the district, within ten working daysfollowing the date of ratification of each agreement, to be: (a) Filed with the superintendent of public instruction; (b) Posted on the school district's web site, if the schooldistrict maintains a web site; (c) Made available to the public for inspection during regularbusiness hours in a convenient and identified location at the mainadministrative office of the school district; p. 1 HB 2921 (d) Filed with the superintendent of the educational servicedistrict in which the district is located; and (e) Filed with the board of trustees of the largest public libraryserving the school district. (2) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection. (a) "Collective bargaining agreement" means a master agreement andany amendments, addendums, memorandums, or any other documentsmodifying the master agreement entered into by a school district and anemployee organization. (b) "Employee organization" means any organization, union,association, agency, committee, council, or group of any kind, in whichemployees participate, and that exists for the purpose, in whole or inpart, of collectively bargaining with employers.
